description: `step.steer` with the operator's CHOSEN skills (S68 B7): the queue validates the names at queue time — an unknown name refuses naming every offender; a known-but-unpickable skill (invalid, shadowed) is SKIPPED and reported in the result's optional `skipped`, never silently dropped. The riding names are filed on the steer row beside the operator's PURE text (visible as `skills` in `step.steers`), and at the next turn boundary the wire message is the chosen skills' canonical lines, a blank line, then the text — joined only at the drain. Here `legacy-notes` was known but unpickable, so it is skipped and `caveman` alone rides.
